question: Which seed syllables are used to perform the six-limb ritual placement?
premises: The six long syllables kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ are specified.
The previous seed is also to be used.
These are applied to the six-limb placement.
inference: The six-limb placement is performed with the six long syllables and the previous seed.
plain_english: With the six long syllables [kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ | ebhirakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ caret || ] and with the previous seed, one performs the six-limb placement.
